title: Eleven KU Law students honored for scholarship, leadership and service
summary_en: Eleven University of Kansas School of Law students received awards during the spring 2026 semester for distinguishing themselves in scholarship, leadership and service to the law school and the community.
title_cn: Eleven KU Law students honored for scholarship, leadership and service

title: Decline in local newspapers reshapes corporate social responsibility, research finds
summary_en: In a new article, Jun Ho Lee, assistant professor of strategy and international business at the University of Kansas, finds that the decline of local newspapers reduces both external oversight and public visibility, weakening the demand for companies to maintain corporate social responsibility engagement.
title_cn: Decline in local newspapers reshapes corporate social responsibility, research finds
